# Slavic Evangelical Baptist Church of Orange County

> Славянская Евангельская Баптистская Церковь округа Ориндж. A Russian-speaking
> Slavic Baptist congregation in Anaheim, California. Sunday worship at 2:00 PM.

## Key information

- Service times: Sunday worship at 2:00 PM; Bible study on Tuesdays 7:30 PM–9:00 PM (via Skype: live:rusevchurch)
- Location: 310 S Lemon St, Anaheim, CA 92805 (building kindly provided by Bethel Baptist Church)
- Mailing address: PO Box 248, Chino, CA 91708-0248
- Language: Russian (Русский)

## Contact

- General: contact@rusevchurch.org
- Deacon: andrey@rusevchurch.org
- Streaming issues: live@rusevchurch.org
- Bible study (Skype): skype@rusevchurch.org
